title.en: Figure 1-1: Example of a tsume shogi problem

explain.ja: 図1-1は詰将棋の例です。詰将棋は玉のある「玉方」と玉のない「攻方」に分かれ、攻方から玉方の玉を詰ませる手順を考えるもので、必ず攻方から指します。盤の一部の駒だけを使い、駒の動かし方や二歩、打ち歩詰めなどの基本ルールは通常の将棋と同じです。攻方は常に王手をかけ、玉方は逃げます。
explain.en: Figure 1-1 is an example of a tsume-shogi (checkmate problem). The sides are the defender (玉方), who has the king, and the attacker (攻方), who has none; you find a sequence in which the attacker mates, and the attacker always moves first. Only some pieces on the board are used, and basic rules such as piece movement, nifu and uchifuzume are the same as normal shogi. The attacker must give check on every move and the defender runs.

section.ja: 攻方と玉方に分かれ、玉方を詰ますことを目指す
section.en: Split into attacker and defender, and aim to checkmate the defender

title.ja: 図1-2 2回王手をかけて詰んだ

explain.ja: 攻方は持ち駒の金で王手を重ね、無事に詰ませました。この手順を見つければ解けたことになります。玉方は2手目に△2一玉と逃げていますが、△3一玉や△4一玉などもあり、どう逃げても詰ませる手があります。玉方のどんな受けにも詰みがあると確認して初めて解けたと言えます。
explain.en: The attacker gave repeated checks with a gold in hand and mated. Finding this sequence solves the problem. The defender fled with △2一玉 on the second move, but △3一玉, △4一玉 and others are possible too, and there is a mate against every escape. A problem is solved only when you confirm a mate against any defence.

section.ja: 攻方は連続で王手して玉方を詰ませる手順を考える
section.en: The attacker plans a sequence of consecutive checks to checkmate the defender

title.en: Figure 2-1: Example of a one-move tsume shogi problem

explain.ja: 詰将棋には1手で詰むものも、何度も王手して詰ませるものもあります。手数は攻方と玉方の指した手の合計数で数えます。図2-1で考えてみましょう。
explain.en: Some tsume problems are mate in one and others need many checks. The move count is the total of the attacker's and defender's moves. Consider Figure 2-1.

section.ja: 詰将棋の手数って?3手詰めって何手なの?
section.en: How many moves in tsume shogi? What does a mate in 3 mean?

explain.ja: 図2-1からは▲2二金の1手で詰むので、1手詰の詰将棋です。
explain.en: From Figure 2-1, ▲2二金 is checkmate in one move, so it is a mate-in-1 problem.

section.ja: 詰将棋の手数って?3手詰めって何手なの?
section.en: How many moves in tsume shogi? What does a mate in 3 mean?

title.en: Figure 2-3: Example of a seven-move tsume shogi problem

explain.ja: では図2-3は何手詰でしょうか。詰むまでに必要な指し手の合計数を数えてみましょう。
explain.en: How many moves is Figure 2-3? Count the total number of moves needed to reach mate.

section.ja: 詰将棋の手数って?3手詰めって何手なの?
section.en: How many moves in tsume shogi? What does a mate in 3 mean?

explain.ja: 図2-3からは7手指して詰みになるので、7手詰です。手数には攻方の王手だけでなく玉方の手も含まれる点に注意しましょう。詰将棋は攻方から始まり攻方の手で終わるので、手数は奇数になります。
explain.en: From Figure 2-3 mate comes after seven moves, so it is a mate in 7. Note that the count includes the defender's moves as well as the attacker's checks. A tsume problem starts and ends with an attacker move, so the move count is always odd.

section.ja: 詰将棋の手数って?3手詰めって何手なの?
section.en: How many moves in tsume shogi? What does a mate in 3 mean?

line.text: ▲1五歩、△1三玉、▲1四歩、△1二玉、▲1三歩成、△1一玉、▲1二と

title.en: Figure 3-1: How many moves to checkmate?

explain.ja: 詰将棋のルールの一つに、玉方は最長手順になるように逃げなければならない、というものがあります。図3-1を解きながら、玉方の逃げ方を考えてみましょう。何手詰か考えてみてください。
explain.en: One rule of tsume-shogi is that the defender must flee so that the sequence is longest. Let us consider the defender's escapes while solving Figure 3-1, and think about how many moves it takes.

section.ja: 玉方は最長手順になるように逃げる
section.en: The king side flees so as to make the longest possible sequence

title.ja: 図3-2 まずは金で王手する
title.en: Figure 3-2: First, check with the gold

explain.ja: 図3-1ではまず金で王手します。次は玉方の番ですが、最長手順になる逃げ方はどれでしょうか。
explain.en: In Figure 3-1 begin by checking with the gold. It is then the defender's turn: which escape produces the longest sequence?

section.ja: 玉方は最長手順になるように逃げる
section.en: The king side flees so as to make the longest possible sequence

title.ja: 図3-3 一見すると3手詰めだが…？
title.en: Figure 3-3: It looks like a three-move mate, but...?

explain.ja: 図3-2から相手玉が△6二玉と逃げれば合計3手で詰みます。これで解けたようにも見えますが、本当にこの手順で正しいでしょうか。
explain.en: From Figure 3-2, if the king flees to △6二玉 the mate comes in three moves in total. That looks like a solution, but is this really the correct line?

section.ja: 玉方は最長手順になるように逃げる
section.en: The king side flees so as to make the longest possible sequence

title.ja: 図3-4 5手詰になる順が正しい手順
title.en: Figure 3-4: The correct sequence is a five-move mate

explain.ja: 図3-2から△4二玉と逃げれば5手詰になります。玉方は5手詰になるような手順で逃げるのが正しい指し手です。詰みまでがなるべく長くなる受けを考えるのも問題の一部です。
explain.en: From Figure 3-2, escaping with △4二玉 leads to a mate in 5. The defender's correct play is the escape that gives the mate in 5, so find the defence that makes the mate as long as possible; working this out is part of the problem.

section.ja: 玉方は最長手順になるように逃げる
section.en: The king side flees so as to make the longest possible sequence

title.ja: 図4-1 詰みの順を考えてみよう
title.en: Figure 4-1: Think about the checkmate sequence

explain.ja: 詰将棋では、玉方は盤上にない玉以外の駒をすべて持ち駒として使えます。図4-1の詰将棋でその例を見てみましょう。
explain.en: In tsume-shogi the defender may use all pieces not on the board, except the king, as pieces in hand. Look at Figure 4-1 for an example.

section.ja: 玉方は、盤上にない全ての駒を持ち駒として使える
section.en: The king side may use every piece not on the board as a piece in hand

title.ja: 図4-2 持ち駒で合駒ができる
title.en: Figure 4-2: A piece in hand can be dropped to interpose

explain.ja: 図4-1から▲5一飛成と王手すれば、玉方に逃げ道がないように見えますが、実際には2一の地点に合駒をして手数を稼げます。
explain.en: In Figure 4-1, after the check ▲5一飛成 the defender seems to have no escape, but in fact can interpose a piece at 2一 to gain extra moves.

section.ja: 玉方は、盤上にない全ての駒を持ち駒として使える
section.en: The king side may use every piece not on the board as a piece in hand

title.ja: 図4-3 持ち駒の桂を使って3手詰め
title.en: Figure 4-3: Three-move mate using the knight in hand

explain.ja: 最後に持ち駒の桂で王手すれば、3手詰になりました。持ち駒を何でも使えるといっても、飛車を3枚以上使うなど、通常の将棋で持てない枚数は使えません。基本ルールは普通の将棋と同じです。
explain.en: Finally, checking with a knight in hand finishes it as a mate in 3. Though any pieces in hand may be used, you cannot use more than normal shogi allows, such as three rooks. The basic rules are those of ordinary shogi.

section.ja: 玉方は、盤上にない全ての駒を持ち駒として使える
section.en: The king side may use every piece not on the board as a piece in hand

title.ja: 図5-1 何手詰めになる？
title.en: Figure 5-1: How many moves to checkmate?

explain.ja: 詰将棋では、無駄な合駒は禁止です。図5-1の詰将棋で無駄な合駒について解説します。
explain.en: In tsume-shogi, a futile interposition is forbidden. Figure 5-1 is used to explain futile interpositions.

section.en: Do not make a wasted interposition

title.ja: 図5-2 玉方は逃げ道がないが…
title.en: Figure 5-2: The king has no escape, but...

explain.ja: 図5-1からは▲2六桂と桂馬を退かして王手します。玉方は合駒をすれば粘れそうですが、ここでの合駒は無駄な合駒になります。無駄な合駒は禁止なので、図5-2で詰んでいるとみなし、図5-1は1手詰の詰将棋になります。
explain.en: In Figure 5-1, ▲2六桂 moves the knight away to give check. The defender seems able to hold out by interposing, but that interposition would be futile. Since futile interpositions are forbidden, Figure 5-2 counts as mate, and Figure 5-1 is a mate in 1.

section.en: Do not make a wasted interposition

title.ja: 図5-3 無駄な合駒の例 詰将棋では禁止
title.en: Figure 5-3: Example of a futile interposition, prohibited in tsume shogi

explain.ja: たとえば図5-2から△1八歩と合駒すれば手数を稼げますが、これは王手している香車でそのまま取れてしまいます。このように攻方が王手している駒でそのまま取れる合駒を、無駄な合駒と考えます。
explain.en: For example, interposing △1八歩 in Figure 5-2 would gain moves, but the checking lance can simply capture it. An interposition that the attacker can capture with the checking piece itself is regarded as futile.

section.en: Do not make a wasted interposition

title.ja: 図5-4 無駄な合駒をすれば手数は稼げる
title.en: Figure 5-4: A futile interposition can prolong the sequence

explain.ja: 無駄な合駒を続ければ図5-1は15手詰になりますが、そのような手順は詰将棋では禁止です。ルールを覚えたら、初心者向けの1手詰の問題に挑戦してみるとよいでしょう。
explain.en: If futile interpositions were continued, Figure 5-1 would become a mate in 15, but such sequences are forbidden in tsume-shogi. Once you know the rules, try beginner mate-in-1 problems.

section.en: Do not make a wasted interposition
